sample.question:
At each crossing, W means the vertical warp strand is on top and H means the horizontal weft is on top. The ideal first row is visible; each following ideal row rotates the previous pattern right by 1 position(s). Coordinates are zero-based (row,column).
What is the minimum number of crossing repairs, counting the missing crossing, needed to make every displayed row follow the phase rule?
A. 0
B. 2
C. 3
D. 4
E. 5
F. 1
sample.analysis: Generate each ideal row from the base pattern, compare it cell-by-cell with the displayed weave, and count missing or different crossings. There are 1 such crossings, and each requires one independent repair. The answer is F.
